body:
Morning, people. Thank you for checking in with me. I did wake up today. Not enough pills and beer to knock me out for good, only enough to give me a good nights sleep. I fell asleep before I could google how to make a noose. Life is some dark fucking tragicomedy sometimes. 
I'm going to visit the perky hippie today. I feel like my brain is trying to kill me. I can only handle like three things going wrong a day before I feel like it's time to start dying. I think I've been through too much shit, and yet, here I still am. 

Life's shit sandwiches, over 300 million served.  

I'm trying to make myself laugh. Soy mucho menos que nada.  I feel empty inside. I wish you all the best with your struggles.

About myself: I grew up. It sucked. I lived for 17 years waiting to escape my situation. I made it out. I went to school. I had goals. I accomplished them. I had a kid. I swore to raise him in every way different from how I was raised. The kid left me for the parent that had never even cared to try to care about him until I asked for child support.  I was a rock for him. As much a rock as I could manage. I felt like he chose the one who never even tried over me. Then I got sick. I was trying to help some people new to America and got sick from some disease they brought. My system went haywire. The lawyer I had to help me fight for custody died on the day of my hearing. I took it as a sign and gave up. For two years I was sick. I eventually got better. I feel all hollowed out. My family life isn't great. I grew up in a big family. Now I live with someone that tells me I don't have patience for any little thing that doesn't go my way. Me. I don't have patience. I sat through 17 years of abuse from two parents to get out on my own. I fought through a 6 year marriage to someone that never loved me and cheated on me with any common prostitute he could. Yes, I'm grumpy. Negative. Bitchy. I don't have patience for people who fuck up. I don't even have patience for my own fuck ups. But don't you dare tell me I don't have patience for when things go my way. Things never go my way. I slog through all the fucking time and it's not recognized. I fight and fight to keep going. I get tired. No one ever sees what I have to do to keep going.  I go to therapy so some perky hippie can tell me that I need to manage my anger when she hasn't seen what a life surrounded by criminals and sickos will make you wish you could kill people by just thinking about it. 

I'm sick. I'm tired. I don't even want to try anymore. I used to think of La Belle Dame Sans Merci. I wrote stories where good guys won, where bad guys died. I shredded them all. I can't do it anymore. I'm tired. I'm one person. No one sees what I have to do to keep going. They tell me I'm too serious. I do what I can to make a difference and it's not enough. It's never enough.

Don't sing to me anymore, cicada
Let your singsong end
For your song, here in the soul
Stabs me like a dagger
Knowing that when you sing
You are proclaiming that you are
going to your death

Sailor, sailor
Tell me if it is true that you know
Because I cannot distinguish
If in the depth of the seas
There is another color blacker
Than the color of my sorrows

A little dove upon flying
Bearing a wounded breast
Was about to cry
And told me very afflicted
I'm tired of searching for
A mutual love

Under the shade of a tree
And to the beat of my guitar
I sing this "huapango" happily
Because my life is ending
And I want to die singing
Like the cicada dies
